Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily reframed the task to compare US release dates (and even assumed an unverified 1983 US home-video date for Saajan Bina Suhagan) despite the question asking generally which film was released first. This methodological shift and reliance on unconfirmed data could have led to an incorrect conclusion; it also failed to resolve the 1980 vs 1981 discrepancy for Taxi zum Klo using authoritative original release dates.
